hero.zh: 高级感来自节奏，不来自持续占屏。
hero.en: Depth comes from rhythm, not permanent occupation.

intro.zh: 文字、媒体和留白改变密度。3D 只在一个局部问题需要它时出现。
intro.en: Type, media, and whitespace change density. 3D appears only when one local question needs it.

title.en: Begin with scale as an argument.

body.zh: 标题、图像和正文的比例变化先于任何空间特效。
body.en: The ratio between title, image, and body changes before any spatial effect appears.

title.zh: 空间图只回答一个局部问题。
title.en: The spatial figure answers one local question.

body.zh: 这段实时对象解释表面连续性，离开章节后不再跟随。
body.en: This realtime object explains surface continuity and does not follow beyond the section.

title.zh: 最后让信用和证据占满版面。
title.en: End by giving credits and evidence the full field.

body.zh: 收束不是另一个特效，而是信息权重的最后一次变化。
body.en: Closure is not another effect; it is the final change in information weight.
